knowledge.content: Python is a programming language used for application development, automation, data analysis and machine learning.
knowledge.recommendation: Learn Python variables, data types, conditional statements, loops, functions, lists, dictionaries and object-oriented programming. Practice coding problems regularly.

knowledge.content: SQL is used to store, retrieve, filter and manage data in relational databases.
knowledge.recommendation: Learn SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, GROUP BY, HAVING, JOIN, subqueries and aggregate functions. Practice writing queries using sample databases.

knowledge.content: Problem solving involves analyzing problems, developing logical solutions and writing efficient algorithms.
knowledge.recommendation: Practice arrays, strings, searching, sorting, binary search and basic algorithmic problems. Learn to analyze time and space complexity.

knowledge.content: Git is a version control system used to track code changes and collaborate with developers.
knowledge.recommendation: Learn git init, add, commit, push, pull, clone, branch and merge. Practice maintaining projects using GitHub repositories.

knowledge.content: Machine Learning involves building models that learn patterns from data and make predictions.
knowledge.recommendation: Learn supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, model evaluation and scikit-learn.

knowledge.content: Data analysis involves cleaning, processing and interpreting data to identify useful patterns and insights.
knowledge.recommendation: Learn Python Pandas, NumPy, data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, statistical concepts and data visualization.

knowledge.content: Communication is the ability to explain ideas clearly and exchange information effectively with others.
knowledge.recommendation: Practice explaining technical concepts, giving presentations, participating in group discussions and writing clear professional emails.

knowledge.content: Power BI is a business intelligence tool used to create interactive dashboards and reports.
knowledge.recommendation: Learn Power Query, data modeling, relationships, DAX measures, charts, slicers and interactive dashboard creation.

knowledge.content: Microsoft Excel is used for organizing data, performing calculations and creating reports.
knowledge.recommendation: Learn formulas, IF, SUMIF, COUNTIF, lookup functions, sorting, filtering, pivot tables and charts.
